cubby.name: book.welcome.counter.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Welcome to Vanilla Overhaul. Start a new game with Framework and the content modules you want. Every content module requires Framework; the other modules are optional. Customers, factions and shops arrive through ordinary play. This cubby belongs to Storage. Move books into it or put the whole cubby inside the Dossier. Activate a book to read; drag it to move it.

cubby.name: book.welcome.shortcut.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Keep the counter clear by storing guides in this cubby. Modules have separate entries in Mods. Only enabled modules supply their items and services. Recipe books must be placed with the relevant production equipment when crafting; keeping one here does not unlock production remotely. Replacement guides and empty cubbies are sold with kitchen books when Trading is installed.

cubby.name: book.neighborhood.people.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Open FACTIONS and use Next to find the new communities after the vanilla groups. Hover reputation milestones to see what they offer and what happens if your standing falls.\n\nOpen your shop and serve visitors normally. Neon Undertow adds regulars to the customer pools, including the Velvet Quay community and upper-class visitors. Story customers keep their original roles.

cubby.name: book.neighborhood.night.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
Once the shop closes, use the normal travel/map menu to visit the night shops.

Quayside Canning Co-op stocks produce, cans, kitchen supplies and books. Its shelves are divided into SODA SUPPLIES, PRODUCE, KITCHEN + BOOKS and CELLAR. Finish a purchase or return the unbought item before changing shelves.

Stock renews daily. Your faction standing can affect offers and prices.

cubby.name: book.neighborhood.equipment.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Stormglass Depot Outlet carries storage and water equipment. Undertow Engineering supplies production modules, attachments and packaging pattern chips.\n\nGlassmarket Counter & Fixture Stall stocks signs, lamps and bar equipment: a tool rail, measures, a mixing glass, shaker, blender, serving glass and a bartender's notebook. The tools are separate items; the rail is storage for them.

cubby.name: book.neighborhood.backroom.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
Click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop to reach the back room. The worktop shares your front counter stock; click it to cook. Click the cabinet or a fitted machine to open it, and the door to return to the shop.

Joe Wild's BACK ROOM services add station bays, storage tiers and fitted equipment. Buy the actual machine before fitting it.

Keep this guide and the book cubby in the main area if that is where you prefer to read.

cubby.name: book.workshop.cooking.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
Buy cooking tools and recipe books at Quayside Canning Co-op. Click the back-room worktop to open the kitchen. Fit tools in their top slots and charged cells in BATTERIES. Put ingredients, water and an optional fridge in INPUT. A fridge needs its own battery.

Choose a dish from your recipe books, then press Craft: the listed ingredients, water and power are consumed. Tools and books are kept. Heated recipes still need a galley or a heating plate; chilled recipes need a powered fridge.

For an unambiguous single-ingredient recipe, you can also drag the matching tool onto the ingredient.

cubby.name: book.workshop.canning.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
Buy the Fizzworks Soda Canner at Stormglass Depot Outlet after hours.

Put the Fizzyworks recipe book in the canning machine input. For other production recipes, use the matching recipe manual and the game's item picker. Supply the listed ingredients, water, packaging and power. Tools and books are kept.

Soda accepts water above Basewater grade. Source water and container condition affect quality. Flavour ingredients are not dirty water.

To make empty metal packaging, use the native printer with a matching chip from Undertow Engineering, metal, the required modules and charged batteries.

cubby.name: book.workshop.water.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
The Industrial Water Generator becomes available at Stormglass Depot from day 28 when you have a Grand Waterworks installed. Its list price is 12,500 credits.

Fit a charged cell. Overnight it generates and fills up to four native 2 L high-quality water bottles, using six power each: 24 for a full set. It needs no ingredient or empty-bottle input. Leave room in OUTPUT.

Starting traits do not grant this generator. Items left in older input or attachment slots stay retrievable. The Waterworks handbook explains the manual bottling equipment and its recipes.

cubby.name: book.workshop.cellar.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
The Co-op's CELLAR shelf sells a Cellar Bench, Brewing Notes, bottles and culture. Its 76 recipes cover suitable fruits, grains, starch crops and infusions. Choose Ferment, Distill or Infuse and load one combination; batches take nights.

The CELLAR tab stores finished bottles. Use the native powered Age-Well rack for suitable wines, cider and perry. Bottled spirits do not mature merely by being stored.

At the bar, pour using ordinary inventory targeting. Measure portions, activate the mixing glass to stir or the shaker to shake, then pour into a bottle. Stir carbonated drinks. The blender extracts produce juices. Read the bartender's notebook for quantities and recipes.

cubby.name: book.help.missing.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Check that Framework and the module owning the missing feature are enabled. Optional modules do not create each other's goods. Recipe options require the appropriate ingredients, tools, water, packaging and power. If an item is unavailable, check its supplier and progression day. For a bug report, include the active modules, game version and Player.log.

cubby.name: book.help.saves.body
Undertow Book Cubby: The modular Vanilla Overhaul collection requires a new game. Do not activate it alongside the older combined Neon Undertow mod. Disabling a content module can leave its items and story state unavailable; restart and begin a new run after changing your module selection. Keep backups of runs you want to retain.

cubby.name: book.help.report.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
If back-room cargo cannot load, saving is blocked to protect the original items. Return to the menu and report the problem.

For a bug report, include the game and mod versions, whether the save is new or existing, other enabled mods, and the steps that led to the problem. A screenshot helps. Startup failures are recorded in Player.log.

The guide explains the tools; it does not repair items, test liquids or skip recipe requirements.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.firstnight.body
Undertow Book Cubby: After closing, visit Quayside Canning Co-op using the travel menu. Buy a chopping board from KITCHEN + BOOKS, plus an apple and a cabbage from PRODUCE.\n\nBack home, click the arrow at the bottom right of the shop, then click the worktop. Follow First meal in this cubby's Workshop Fieldbook. You do not need to fit a station just to open the kitchen. Keep your guides: their index lets you return to any lesson.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.firstmeal.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Fit a chopping board in its top kitchen slot. Put one apple and one cabbage in INPUT, then open COOK. Click Apple Slaw and collect it from OUTPUT. This starter recipe needs no water, battery or heating plate.\n\nFor other meals, read their recipe book. Fit the matching tool; supply any listed water and power. A heating plate or galley provides heat for a pan or saucepan, but does not replace the tool. A fridge needs its own battery.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.bottling.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Open the Manual Bottling Kit. Put the Undertow Bottling Handbook, matching concentrate, water at 99% purity or higher and an empty 350/500 mL can or 750 mL glass bottle in INPUT.\n\nChoose a ready drink in the middle. It uses one concentrate, one container and that container's capacity in water. Collect the labelled drink from OUTPUT. The kit needs no power. Plastic water bottles are not soda packaging. Keep space for the result.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.growing.body
Undertow Book Cubby:
These crops are genetically modified compact varieties bred for standard hydroponic growers. Even the fruit trees stay small.

Buy fruit or vegetable seed assortments from the Co-op's PRODUCE shelf. Open a packet and put one seed in the vanilla hydroponic unit's seed slot. Add a charged battery and a water container; use the plant analyser to check the crop's nutrient needs.

Growth uses the normal machine cycles, water and plant-health rules. Collect produce and returned seeds from OUTPUT. Healthy crops can yield large and huge produce, just like Nutrifruit. Keep seeds to plant the next generation.

The SEEDS shelf sells packs of three seeds of one crop. Select SEEDS again to switch between fruits and vegetables.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.genetics.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Our crop seeds use the vanilla plant DNA system. Read the DNA Manipulator's instruction note. Put a compatible written trait disk in TRAIT DISK, a seed in TARGET and supply power. Check the operation and success chance before starting.\n\nFor extraction, use the BLANK DISK slot and read the displayed risks. Successful edits can change growth, yield, water demand or produce properties. Returned seeds inherit the parent's traits. Keep a spare strain: edits can fail, and incompatible traits remain restricted.

cubby.name: book.tutorial.stuck.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Click the back-room worktop and select COOK. The cabinet's FITTED STATION slot is not the cooking tool selector. Fit tools in the top slots; put ingredients in INPUT and leave OUTPUT space.\n\nNo recipes? Check the exact ingredients, tool, water, power and heating or chilling requirements. TOOL: Chopping Board with heat/work controls is the older interface, retained for an unfinished saved batch. Finish that batch to return to ready recipes. If still stuck, report your version and a full-window screenshot.

cubby.name: book.lab.bench.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Buy compound cylinders from Glassmarket. Mix equal measures of the two named stocks with a little water in one cylinder. Try 2 mL of each and 1 mL of water. Heat until both stocks have reacted. Check the mixture with the composition spectrometer. For dry recipes use the evaporator, then select the product in the Chem Finisher. Cards give the minimum heat and the volume per pack.

cubby.name: book.bio.split.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Make the first-stage mixture on the heating plate. Before drying or finishing it, split it into two cylinders. For each 6 mL of active compound use 6 mL of just one additive and leave at least 0.5 mL of extra water. Heat to 55 °C. Use fresh juice from the blender or clean milk from a nursing spotted rat. Two competing additives block that branch. Check the spectrometer before finishing.

cubby.name: book.wave.safety.body
Undertow Book Cubby: Use water and low heat. A dry mix of Dock Chalk and Emberwake on high heat can explode. If the cylinder rattles, take it off or turn the plate down immediately. Once the countdown starts, the batch is lost and the explosion ends the run.
